instruction.name: movgr2cf
instruction.description: Move the low bit of rj into condition code cd.

experiments.name: register round trip
experiments.notes: Register round trip measured at 21.99 cycles (five runs ranged 21.99-22.00); subtracting the 7-cycle movcf2gr leaves 15. Only the sum of the two flag-register directions is observable in a closed chain, so the 7/15 split is a microarchitectural choice: the flag read is the short direction, as the movcf2gr closure of fcmp/vset shows.

latencies.notes: movcf2gr+movgr2cf round trip is 22 cycles; fcmp+movcf2gr+movgr2fr is 11 cycles with fcmp=1 and movgr2fr=1, giving movcf2gr=9 and movgr2cf=13. Unroll 10000, iters 1000. Raw measurement was 13.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movgr2cf $fcc0, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc1, $r5; movgr2cf $fcc2, $r6; movgr2cf $fcc3, $r7; movgr2cf $fcc4, $r8; movgr2cf $fcc5, $r9; movgr2cf $fcc6, $r10; movgr2cf $fcc7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'movgr2cf $fcc0, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc1, $r5; movgr2cf $fcc2, $r6; movgr2cf $fcc3, $r7; movgr2cf $fcc4, $r8; movgr2cf $fcc5, $r9; movgr2cf $fcc6, $r10; movgr2cf $fcc7, $r11'

notes: movgr2cf is 15 cycles. Measured as a closed register round trip with the opposite direction subtracted; the round trip is additive with known-latency instructions inserted in between. Every cross-domain move on LA464 is 2 cycles per direction, with movgr2frh.w at 3 and the flag pair at 7/15 cycles. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
